title: Pascal's Triangle
description: Write a Zig program that generates and prints Pascal's triangle up to 5 rows.
hints: Each row starts and ends with 1
Interior values are the sum of the two values above: `row[i][j] = row[i-1][j-1] + row[i-1][j]`
Use a 2D fixed-size array initialized with `undefined`
